summary.goal: Enable all agents (persistent and spawned) to be first-class citizens via MCP tools. Agents self-report their status, ask questions directly, and join plan channels. Both agent types use identical interfaces - MCP is the unified protocol.

acceptance_criteria.description: MCP tool 'report_agent_status' allows agents to report state (working/idle/needs_input/error) with activity text
MCP tool 'ask_user_question' allows agents to create questions in the queue (sets needs_input state)
MCP tool 'join_plan_channel' allows agents to join plan channels via adminJoinChannel
Spawned agents appear in UI status bar when they call report_agent_status
Spawned agents can send messages to plan channel after joining
Questions from spawned agents show in Question Queue with needs_input indicator
Spawned agent task includes MCP server URL and plan context
Plan channels visible in relay dashboard with correct membership
PRESENCE comes from relay daemon listConnectedAgents(), STATE comes from agent-status broadcasts
PlannerLead uses same MCP tools as spawned agents (dogfooding)

out_of_scope_v1: Agent health monitoring (relay provides basic health)
Automatic state cleanup on agent disconnect (use relay presence)

steps.title: Create report_agent_status MCP tool
steps.description: Add MCP tool for agents to report their state. Stores state in agent-status registry and broadcasts via relay. Both persistent and spawned agents use this.

acceptance_criteria.description: Tool accepts: agentId, role, state, activity?, thought?
Tool calls emitAgentJoined() on first report (registers agent)
Tool calls emitAgentStatusUpdate() on subsequent reports
State broadcasts received by UI via relay

architecture.principle: MCP as the unified interface - both persistent and spawned agents use identical tools
architecture.key_insight: Spawned agents CAN call MCP tools (separate processes with HTTP access). This makes them first-class citizens with no proxy needed.

planner_core_provides: Rich status info - activity, step, thought/question text
MCP tools - unified interface for all agents

removed: spawnedAgents Map in client.ts (use relay's tracking)
kept: emitAgentStatusUpdate - called by MCP tools, not directly by planner-core

data_flow.agent_state_reporting: Agent -> MCP report_agent_status -> agent-status registry -> relay broadcast -> UI
data_flow.agent_question_asking: Agent -> MCP ask_user_question -> question DB + needs_input state -> UI queue
data_flow.agent_channel_join: Agent -> MCP join_plan_channel -> adminJoinChannel -> relay membership
data_flow.presence_query: UI -> GET /api/agents -> listConnectedAgents() + activeAgents -> merged response

report_agent_status.input: { agentId: string, role: AgentRole, state: AgentState, activity?: string, thought?: string }
report_agent_status.behavior: First call registers agent (emitAgentJoined), subsequent calls update state (emitAgentStatusUpdate)

ask_user_question.input: { planId: string, question: string, options?: string[], context?: string }
ask_user_question.behavior: Creates question in DB, sets agent state to needs_input with question as thought

spawn_flow.1_spawn: PlannerLead calls spawnAgent({ name, task, planId })
spawn_flow.2_relay_handles: Relay daemon spawns process, tracks presence
spawn_flow.4_task_includes: MCP server URL + planId + instructions to use MCP tools
spawn_flow.5_agent_reports: Spawned agent calls MCP report_agent_status on start
spawn_flow.6_agent_works: Agent uses MCP tools for questions, status updates

steps.title: Create ask_user_question MCP tool
steps.description: Add MCP tool for agents to ask questions. Creates question in DB, sets agent state to needs_input, broadcasts to UI.

acceptance_criteria.description: Tool accepts: planId, question, options?, context?
Tool creates question in storage (existing question API)
Tool sets agent state to needs_input with question as thought
Returns questionId for tracking answer

steps.title: Create join_plan_channel MCP tool
steps.description: Add MCP tool for agents to join plan channels. Uses relay adminJoinChannel() to add agent to channel membership.

acceptance_criteria.description: Tool accepts: planId (derives channel name)
Tool calls adminJoinChannel(planChannel, callingAgentName)
Returns success/failure with channel name

steps.title: Update spawn flow with MCP context
steps.description: When spawning agents, include MCP server URL in task. Optionally pre-register channel membership for immediate communication.

acceptance_criteria.description: Spawned agent task includes MCP server URL (e.g., http://localhost:3001)
Spawned agent task includes planId for context
adminJoinChannel() called immediately after spawn for instant channel access
Task instructs agent to use MCP tools for status/questions

steps.title: Migrate PlannerLead to use MCP tools
steps.description: Refactor PlannerLead to use the same MCP tools as spawned agents. Proves the interface works for both agent types.

acceptance_criteria.description: PlannerLead calls report_agent_status MCP tool for state changes
PlannerLead calls ask_user_question MCP tool (not direct emitAgentStatusUpdate)
Behavior identical to current but via MCP

steps.title: Remove duplicate presence tracking
steps.description: Remove manual agent presence tracking that duplicates relay daemon functionality. Use listConnectedAgents() for presence, agent-status for state.

acceptance_criteria.description: Remove spawnedAgents Map from client.ts (relay tracks this)
activeAgents Map tracks STATE only, not presence
emitAgentLeft() called from relay disconnect callback (if agent goes offline)

steps.title: Add presence polling/subscription
steps.description: Frontend should poll or subscribe to relay presence for who's online, merged with agent-status for rich state.

acceptance_criteria.description: API endpoint /api/agents returns merged presence + state
Presence from listConnectedAgents(), state from activeAgents registry
Frontend useAgentOrchestration uses this endpoint

steps.title: Verify end-to-end flow
steps.description: Integration test: spawn agent, agent reports status via MCP, asks question via MCP, appears correctly in UI.

acceptance_criteria.description: Spawn agent -> agent calls MCP report_agent_status -> appears in status bar
Agent calls MCP ask_user_question -> question in queue, agent shows needs_input
Agent calls MCP join_plan_channel -> can send/receive in channel
Plan channels visible in relay dashboard with correct members

change_history.change: Revised architecture to use MCP as unified interface for all agents
change_history.reason: User pointed out spawned agents CAN call MCP tools - no need for emit-on-behalf pattern
change_history.impact: Both persistent and spawned agents now use identical interfaces
